 Weather Tomorrow Friday, November 13, 2026: BMKG Issues Heavy Rain Alert for 5 Provinces
 The weather forecast for Friday, November 13, 2026, indicates that heavy rain is expected in five provinces, with the BMKG urging residents to remain vigilant.
 By: Fadhila Nuraini 
 | 
 Editor: Damar Prasetya 
 | 
 Contributor: Adit Pranata 
 November 12, 2026, 21:58 WITA · 5 min read 
 Close ad × 
 Advertisement 
 Photo caption: Illustration of heavy rain pouring over an urban area and disrupting vehicle activity. The BMKG warns of the potential for heavy rain in several regions of Indonesia on Friday, November 13, 2026. (Illustration/Aktualita.co) 
 JAKARTA, Aktualita.co -  The weather forecast for tomorrow , Friday (13/11/2026), shows that the potential for rain remains in several regions of Indonesia. The Meteorology, Climatology, and Geophysics Agency (BMKG) reminds the public to increase vigilance against heavy rain that may be accompanied by lightning and strong winds. 
 Based on the weather early warning update for Friday, November 13, 2026, there are five provinces categorized as being on high alert for heavy rain. Meanwhile, several other regions are forecast to experience light to moderate rain. 
 Advertisement 
 These conditions should be a concern for people planning to travel, work outdoors, or carry out daily activities. This is because weather changes can occur in a relatively short time, especially in areas with active rain cloud formation. 
 In the weather outlook for the period of 10–16 November 2026, the BMKG explains that atmospheric activity still supports the formation of rain clouds in various regions. 
 Five Provinces on High Alert for Heavy Rain 
 Based on the BMKG's daily early warning update for Friday, November 13, 2026, the five provinces with regions under high alert status for heavy rain include: 
 North Sumatra 
 Bangka Belitung Islands 
 West Java 
 Central Java 
 South Papua 
 The high alert status indicates the potential for heavy to very heavy rain in the areas covered by the warning. However, this does not mean that all regencies or cities within those provinces will experience the same weather conditions. 
 Residents living in low-lying areas, river basins, or hilly slopes need to be aware of the possibility of flooding, inundation, and landslides if the rain persists with high intensity. 
 In addition to these five provinces, several other regions are also in the alert category, including Aceh, West Sumatra, Riau, Riau Islands, Jambi, South Sumatra, Bengkulu, Lampung, Banten, Jakarta, Yogyakarta, East Java, Bali, and West Nusa Tenggara. 
 The potential for rain should also be noted in parts of Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Maluku, and Papua. 
 Weather Forecast for Jakarta, Bandung, Semarang, and Surabaya 
 For the DKI Jakarta region, the BMKG forecast shows varied weather conditions on Friday, November 13, 2026. 
 Central Jakarta, West Jakarta, and North Jakarta are forecast to be mostly cloudy. Meanwhile, South Jakarta and East Jakarta have the potential for light rain. 
 Air temperatures in the Jakarta area are generally forecast to range between 25–33 degrees Celsius, depending on the location. 
 In Bandung, several districts such as Sukasari, Coblong, and Babakan Ciparay are forecast to experience light rain. Air temperatures in these areas will range between 20–29 degrees Celsius. 
 Meanwhile, the Central Semarang and North Semarang regions also have the potential for light rain with air temperatures around 26–33 degrees Celsius. 
 Different conditions are forecast for parts of Surabaya. Several districts, including Karang Pilang, Wonocolo, and Rungkut, are expected to experience hazy conditions with air temperatures that could reach 35 degrees Celsius in some locations. 
 Nevertheless, the public still needs to follow the latest forecast updates because the potential for rain can change according to local atmospheric conditions. 
 Medan Weather Has Potential for Moderate Rain, Makassar Tends to be Hot 
 In North Sumatra, Medan City is one of the regions that needs to pay attention to the potential for increased rainfall. 
 The BMKG forecasts that several districts, including Medan Kota and Medan Sunggal, have the potential for moderate rain on Friday, November 13, 2026. Air temperatures are expected to range between 24–30 degrees Celsius. 
 In Palembang, South Sumatra, light rain is forecast to occur in several areas, including Ilir Barat Dua and Seberang Ulu Satu. 
 Meanwhile, the weather forecast for Makassar City shows relatively different conditions. Mariso District is predicted to be sunny, while Mamajang and Makassar are forecast to be partly cloudy. 
 Air temperatures in several Makassar districts are expected to reach 35 degrees Celsius. Although the weather tends to be hot, the potential for local rain cloud growth still needs to be monitored. 
 In South Papua, the weather forecast for the Merauke Regency area also varies. Merauke District is predicted to be cloudy, while Muting and Okaba have the potential for light rain. 
 These differences in forecasts show that provincial-level warning statuses do not always reflect the same conditions across all administrative areas. 
 Why is Rain Still Likely to Occur? 
 In an atmospheric analysis published on November 10, 2026, the BMKG explained that the increase in rain activity is influenced by several meteorological factors. 
 One of them is the activity of the Madden-Julian Oscillation (MJO), an atmospheric phenomenon that can support the formation of rain clouds when environmental conditions allow. 
 The BMKG also noted the influence of equatorial atmospheric waves, including the Equatorial Rossby wave, as well as the presence of wind convergence and deceleration zones. 
 The combination of these conditions can increase the growth of convective clouds that have the potential to produce rain, including localized heavy rain. 
 In the forecast for the period of 13–16 November 2026, the BMKG provided a general overview of national weather conditions. 
 "The weather in Indonesia is generally dominated by light intensity rain." This was the statement from the BMKG in the Indonesian weather forecast for the period of 13–16 November 2026. 
 Although light rain is generally forecast, an increase in rain intensity can still occur in several regions. 
 The BMKG also highlighted the potential for heavy rain in the Highlands of Papua during those few days, as well as the potential for strong winds in the Riau Islands and the Highlands of Papua. These multi-day forecasts have a different period from the daily early warning for Friday. 
 Beware of Floods, Lightning, and Sudden Weather Changes 
 The public is advised to prepare for Friday's activities by considering the possibility of weather changes. 
 Motorcyclists should carry rain gear and avoid traveling during very heavy rain if visibility decreases. 
 Residents living in flood-prone areas also need to ensure that water channels are not clogged, while people in hilly areas should pay attention to signs of soil movement after prolonged rain. 
 When rain is accompanied by lightning, activities in open fields, under tall trees, and in locations at risk of being struck by lightning should be avoided. 
 For regions forecast to be hot, including parts of Makassar and Surabaya, the public is also advised to maintain fluid intake and reduce exposure to excessive heat. 
 The weather forecast for tomorrow, Friday, November 13, 2026, may be updated according to atmospheric developments. The public should check BMKG information before starting activities, especially for regions currently under an early warning status. 
 Weather information down to the district and sub-district level can be monitored through the official BMKG website and the InfoBMKG application.
